abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.
